title: Accessibility Review Workflow
description: AIL 606 textbook section on running a WCAG-anchored accessibility review of a prototype: mapping elements to WCAG 2.2 success criteria, prioritizing fixes by depth of exclusion, and adding redundant cues for learner variability, with reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Map each element of a prototype screen to a named WCAG 2.2 success criterion (1.1.1, 1.4.1, 1.4.3, 2.1.1, 2.2.1) rather than judging by appearance
Prioritize accessibility fixes by depth of exclusion, fixing full lock-outs before strain
Add redundant cues (color plus label plus icon) consistent with UDL learner variability without raising load for other learners
Judge an AI-drafted alt text against WCAG 1.1.1 (does it name what the image shows and why it matters) before accepting it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
